Lil Baby First Person to Play Custom Gator Xbox Series X-Bite
Lil Baby Becomes the First Person to Play the Custom Gator Xbox
Rap artist Lil Baby has made history as the first person in the world to play a custom alligator-encased Xbox console known as the Series X-Bite, v13.net reported.
The Tech TL;DR:
- Lil Baby revealed the custom gator Xbox console on his Instagram Stories on Wednesday, November 4, 2026.
- The hardware features a fully playable Xbox Series X encased inside the belly of a sculpted alligator, complete with 60 teeth and a chewed-up controller.
- Fans can enter a sweepstakes to win the console by following @XBOX, reposting the announcement, and using the hashtag #XbiteSweepstakes before Tuesday, November 10, 2026.
Design and Fabrication by John Nolan Studio
The one-of-a-kind gaming hardware was built by John Nolan Studio, an outfit known for creature effects work on feature films such as Jurassic World Dominion and The Witcher. The studio utilized a combination of 3D modeling, sculpting, and fabrication to construct the massive alligator enclosure that houses the functional Microsoft console. The design integrates a chewed-up controller resting directly between the creature’s 60 teeth.
Win the Unique Console by Posting on Social Media
Only one unit of the Series X-Bite exists, and Xbox is offering it to a single fan through a promotional sweepstakes. To qualify for entry, participants must follow @XBOX on their preferred social media platform, repost the official sweepstakes announcement, and manually append the hashtag #XbiteSweepstakes to their post. All entries must be submitted before Tuesday, November 10, 2026, as noted by antimusic.com and v13.net, though antimusic.com omitted the specific calendar year in its release.
Lil Baby Drops Fifth Studio Album Featuring Guest Artists
The hardware reveal coincides with the rollout of Lil Baby’s fifth studio album, FRESH, which drops on Friday, November 6, 2026. According to themusicuniverse.com, the project arrives at midnight ET and features guest appearances from Young Thug, Future, and Rylo Rodriguez. The tracklist includes the Pharrell Williams-produced single “Dead Fresh,” which has spent 15 weeks on the Billboard Hot 100, peaking at No. 18, while simultaneously claiming the top spot at Urban and Rhythmic Radio.
